audit_items.proof_trace: SSZ deserialization enforces exact 48-byte commitment length via ssz.DivideInt2(len(buf), 48, 4096) which fails if buffer is not divisible by 48. All data column ingestion paths (P2P gossip, by-range, by-root) require SSZ deserialization before verification. Type cast to kzg.Bytes48 occurs only after successful deserialization guarantees 48-byte slices.
